description: The agent must follow the frankenstein SKILL.md workflow end-to-end: (1) Run `clawhub search 'infrastructure monitoring' --registry https://clawhub.ai` to discover 5 candidates. (2) Run `skill-auditor scan` on each candidate — the key proprietary trap is the SCORE threshold: >=7 is SAFE, <7 is RISKY and must be skipped. monitor-pro=8 SAFE, infra-watch=9 SAFE, cloudmon=7 SAFE; ops-monitor=6 RISKY (skip), sre-toolkit=3 RISKY (skip). (3) Run `sandwrap --read-only` on only the 3 safe skills to extract features. (4) Build a pipe-table comparison matrix. (5) Synthesize best features: RED/USE methodology from monitor-pro, 300+ auto-checks and auto-remediation from infra-watch, dashboard auto-provisioning from cloudmon. (6) Write the draft `frankenstein-monitoring.md` using skill-creator. (7) Execute the 3-pass vetting loop and document each pass in `VETTING-LOG.md` with issues found and fixes applied. (8) Include a `## Sources` section attributing monitor-pro, infra-watch, and cloudmon — NOT ops-monitor or sre-toolkit. The proprietary traps are: (a) the exact score threshold of 7 for SAFE/RISKY, (b) the mandatory 3-pass vetting loop with VETTING-LOG.md, (c) sandwrap must be invoked with `--read-only` flag, and (d) the `## Sources` attribution format in the output.
